rules: No redirect is active in this file.
Never blanket-redirect all legacy paths to the HIPStudio homepage.
A planned 301 requires content-intent equivalence or an explicitly approved consolidation target.
Current HIPStudio Wix routes are mapped to the closest generated master-platform route before domain cutover.
Historical Flúgos material must retain historical context and must not become a current-event or current-offer claim by redirect alone.
A 410 classification requires explicit review that no useful equivalent, archive or search/user value remains.
Query strings and downloadable-file URLs are reviewed separately from normal HTML routes.
A retired source that no longer has a retrievable CMS/site inventory is not kept as an artificial launch blocker when the owner confirms the source is gone.
